notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are nonmajor governmental funds; no enterprise funds, so business_type null). Top-level receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (pp3-4). Beginning cash = printed FUND BALANCES beginning of year 5,292,218 (p5); ending_cash = total assets/fund balances 4,800,537 (p6; includes cash in bank, investments, CDs, county treasurer). Interfund transfers (190,000 in/out) net to zero in the total column via Reclassifications, so transfers_in/out are null. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp11-14) with budget; the General Fund components combining schedule (pp7-9) and nonmajor combining schedule (p10) not recorded again to avoid double counting. GF budget schedule lists program lines only (not itemized by object). The GF O&M of plant lines include 225,000 transferred to the Depreciation Fund (p9 elimination); recorded as a contra expenditure plus an other financing item in detail, and the GF expenditure detail_total 5,934,212 equals expenditure items 5,519,212 plus other financing 190,000+225,000 (=415,000). Printed GF total 5,934,212 includes the 190,000 transfer. Depreciation, Nutrition, Activities printed total receipts include the transfers in. Employee Benefit Fund had no 2025 disbursements (blank). Nonrevenue receipts 23,968 split using p8 (GF) and p20 (Special Building). Students support 763,302 split into GF 277,740 and activities-fund 485,562 per p4 columns/p10. Page mapping: trimmed p1-2 = report pp5-6, p3-6 = pp7-10, p7-9 = pp26-28, p10 = p30, p11-21 = pp32-42. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
